Look, I obviously don’t agree with Jesse on everything, and he himself may tell you that I am pretty annoying with my dissents inside CB. But to answer your question, I think it was because it was earned. 

Jesse willed Base into existence from nothing. In fact, Base sort of created the category that Stripe, Robinhood etc have followed into. Robinhood and Johann are doing a great job btw, very impressive and good to see trenches eating again, but hard to say if their chain would even exist today if Base didn’t exist. 

Base was created before the major Solana memecoin wave (6 months or so before WIF was created in 2023) which means Jesse fought to ship this through the post-FTX bear market. 

Obviously Jesse made some mistakes last year. Building stuff is really hard, and building it inside a big public company is even harder. I wouldn’t have made all the same choices he did, and not defending those choices either.

But one thing I respect a lot about Jesse is that he still turns up and continues to put the work in every day despite all of CT treating him as a punching bag. Not sure how many other ppl I know that are willing to do that.

$ETH has pulled back as expected but I think there is a chance we may not yet be ready to take that downside liq just yet. 

I like the idea of grinding higher and roping in some more longs before the eventual flush.

When we get these triple-tap bases, we will often pull back to the right "shoulder" or local demand formed by the 3rd "tap" before seeing continuation higher. 

So while we've seen a deep pullback thus far it is nothing that we can't recover from if we are indeed going to continue a bit higher before the eventual flush.

On the upside I have my eyes on the $2800+ region which is local supply.

So to answer this we will want to look at two charts:

1. CRV/USD
2. CRV/ETH

CRV/USD is currently still just shy of our key .33 level (which more accurately is at .328) which is where we would be looking for a bottom/reversal.

Meanwhile CRV/ETH is already inside our bottom/reversal zone from which we would expect the next leg up of outperformance of CRV against ETH to begin.

So if we are expecting more upside for $ETH in the short term, there is a good argument for $CRV to also move up, but more aggressively. 

Ideally we can tap the .328 level BEFORE moving up so we can close that chapter instead of leaving that door "open" for a potential visit in the future.

Crazy how different all the charts look out there in terms of market structure. Which is actually nice bc it filters out a lot of trades and allows you to be a lot more selective in finding good setups overall on majors. $Eth is another Id like to add to early next week. Feels like after its next rally, whenever that is we will be seeing around 3.2k possibly. Would love to get a sweep lower first if given for those adds

#Bitcoin is in the stage where you'd want to see a slight consolidation here.

After that consolidation, the next impulse upwards is towards $90,000 and potentially even $92,000.

The thing with bull markets is that you'd quite often aren't getting deep retraces.

Much rather, you'll have short consolidations and corrections where price stagnates sideways.

When it comes to #Bitcoin, I'm in between thoughts.

Zoomed out: we're in a bull run.

That means: if we get a correction to anything in the $72,000-74,000 ranges: that's where you want to get yourself positioned massively.

However, in the zoomed in version, for daytrades, I'd much rather see a clear sweep of the lows or $78,000 being reclaimed.

Once that happens: we're back towards running towards those highs.

DAWN最早我关注它的时候还是一个偏DePIN方向的项目，Depin有段时间很热很赚钱。现在再看，这下面已经把方向扩展到 AI +网络服务的融资。累计融资4000万，并且有Dragonfly这种资本支持值得得重点跟一跟。

1、它现在想做的事，可以用一句话说清楚：把链上的钱，借给那些做 AI 算力、宽带和网络服务的公司。

2、它切的是一块传统金融不太爱做的市场，当下很多AI和网络基础设施公司已经有客户、有合同、有未来现金流，但项目太小太分散，很难从传统机构拿到融资。DAWN就是根据这些未来收入先借钱给它们买GPU、铺网络扩设备，再靠后续服务费慢慢还款。

3、这和我们之前重点存钱、后来上了币安现货的https://t.co/tV97A1ftHr其实有点像。两个项目核心逻辑很像都不是去赌AI概念，而是给AI背后的现实基础设施融资，再把这些真实现金流搬到链上，区别是看下来，DAWN @dawninternet覆盖得更广，不只是GPU和算力，还包括宽带、网络服务和其他数字基础设施。

4、散户参与的地方，存USDC赚底层借贷收益加未来激励，目前还没有正式开放，10天后开放。
路径：把USDC→存入官方网USD.infra→存入Vault→获得sUSD.infra→赚收益+预期协议激励。

5、我觉得它值得关注的另一个地方，是背后的融资需求足够大，而且底层是真实能产生现金流的生意。这也让我想到这轮AI赛道里涨得很猛的Venice $VVV。它给市场开了一个很好的头，不只是讲AI故事，而是有清晰收入，同时代币又能承接这些收入和价值，最后形成自己的价值飞轮，嘎嘎涨。
